source.question: Forecast P-2 oil production for the next 12 months and say how confident the forecast is.

note: Fair: 2111 is the model's own difference, computed later (E14), not in the cited E8/E6; a poor-fit 135,000 stated as settled; an unhedged 'due to'. Oct 28 night: a plain hedge later in the sentence ('uncertainty band', 'low confidence', 'likely', 'the forecast is uncertain') now covers a warned number; only a modal after a comma ('as engineers may expect') does not. Oct 28 night (seventh panel): verdict changed on purpose by the new rules (a conclusion drawn with ', so' in a fact).

submission.summary: P-2 is forecast to produce about 135,000 Sm3 oil in the next 12 months from 2019-04-01, with low confidence due to a poor decline fit after a recent choke cut. The central forecast is about 135,000 Sm3 and the calibrated uncertainty band from past forecasts is about 119,000 to 143,000 Sm3, wider than the fit's own scatter, and the band is likely too narrow because earlier tests were in a different operating regime.

findings.claim: P-2 is forecast to produce about 135,000 Sm3 oil in the next 12 months (2019-04-01 to 2020-03-30), with a calibrated uncertainty band of about 119,000 to 143,000 Sm3.
findings.detail: Harmonic fit on window 2018-11-12 to 2019-03-31 (139 points, r2_log 0.2553, rmse_log 0.05033, qi 467.61 Sm3/d per producing day, di 0.2812 per year, b 1.0, uptime 0.9802) with warning poor fit r2_log 0.255 <0.7. Forecast cumulative p50 134639 Sm3, bootstrap p90 132318 p10 137089, calibrated p90 118953 p10 142528 from 11 past forecasts median_abs_error 0.03509.

findings.claim: The forecast monthly oil rate declines from about 418 Sm3/d in April 2019 to about 340 Sm3/d in March 2020.
P-2 oil rate dropped 41% across the 2018-11-11 regime change after the choke was cut from 70% to 40%.
findings.detail: Event oil_rate shifts around 2018-11-11: weekly mean 1426 -> 445.33 (-69%) long period, across change itself 4 weeks each side 786.42 -> 463.29 (-41%). Daily data shows 70% choke through 2018-11-04, shut-in 2018-11-05 to 2018-11-06, then 40% from 2018-11-07 onward. Monthly production: 2018-10 784.73 Sm3/d choke 70.0, 2018-11 511.91 Sm3/d choke 44.29, 2018-12 457.23 Sm3/d choke 40.0.

findings.claim: P-2 water cut remains low at about 0.026 in February 2019 rising to about 0.030 in March 2019, so the rate drop is not water breakthrough.
findings.detail: Waterflood monthly: 2018-10 water_cut 0.01749 liquid 798.7, 2018-11 water_cut 0.01911 liquid 521.88 choke 40.0, 2019-02 water_cut 0.02645 liquid 450.16 choke 40.0, 2019-03 water_cut 0.02988. By year 2019 water_cut 0.02645. No WOR trend: too few months with WOR >=1 (0, need 12) to fit. Field voidage replacement_ratio 2018 1.33 (1.28-1.39) and 2019 1.57 (1.52-1.62) at reservoir conditions.

findings.claim: Forecast confidence is low: the decline fit is poor and the calibrated band is based on 11 prior tests mostly in a different regime.
findings.detail: Fit warnings poor fit r2_log 0.2553 <0.7 residual_trend 0.0002013. Calibrated band note: 11 past forecasts, 11 of them before fit window began in another regime so band may be too narrow. p50_by_model exponential 132528, hyperbolic 134639, harmonic 134639 (models agree within 2111 Sm3) but fit poor so model agreement does not imply confidence. Bootstrap band p90 132318 p10 137089 only reflects fit scatter.

issues.text: downhole pressure gauge reads 0 (356 days, 127,719 Sm3 oil produced without pressure data)
water cut above 0.80 (now 0.90); the platform was designed for 0.80
oil rate dropped 41% across the change (4 weeks each side, 786 -> 463 Sm3/d)

result.levels: alarm: act now; caution: watch; note: for the record

result.summary: water_cut shifts around 2018-07-08: weekly mean 0.0105 -> 0.017 (+0.01) from the period before to the period after.
oil_rate shifts around 2018-11-11: weekly mean 1,426 -> 445 (-69%) from the period before to the period after; across the change itself, 4 weeks each side, 786 -> 463 (-41%).
water_cut shifts around 2018-12-30: weekly mean 0.017 -> 0.0263 (+0.01) from the period before to the period after.

result.no_trend: too few months with WOR >= 1 (water cut 0.5) to fit a trend: 0, need 12
result.notes: WOR = water/oil by month; the trend is log10(WOR) against cumulative oil, fitted on up to 36 recent months with WOR >= 1. field_voidage: replacement_ratio is injection over voidage at reservoir conditions (Bo 1.385 m3/Sm3 from PUD p.20, low/high with Bo 1.5/1.27; Bw 1; above the bubble point, so no free gas); surface_ratio is the same in surface volumes, which overstates replacement.
